confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Sydney prices, projected to July 2026; not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Cafe, pub and restaurant anchors are better grounded than accommodation, which varies widely by area and event calendar; hotel and hostel figures reflect off-peak winter levels. Beer assumes ordinary pubs, not upscale hotel bars. Cocktail and wine rely on direct knowledge of typical Sydney bar prices, cross-checked against beer (about 1.7x and 1.15x). FX was taken from search results attributed to the RBA page and was not directly opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No substitute city used; anchored on Sydney's own price levels, with a loose sense-check against Melbourne for cafe, restaurant and pub prices.
